search_window.basis: Previous verified Care Line Watch completion through this execution; supplementary recall only; production collector authoritative.

coverage_notes.scope: U.S., DC, and territories. Focused on concrete hospital/ED, maternity, behavioral health, dialysis, oncology, primary care, and rural emergency service suspensions/closures; ambulance and air-medical bases; CMS terminations/rescissions/CLIA actions; and real essential-service reopenings.

cms_public_notices.result: Directly inspected official notice listing before all targeted searches. No 2026-10-31 notice appeared; seven 2026-10-30 provider termination notices previously recorded in Care Line Watch.

coverage_notes.result_summary: CMS Public Notices directly checked first, then twelve targeted web searches. No new, substantiated, nonduplicate qualifying access change, CMS action, or concrete restoration identified between previous verified completion and this check.
coverage_notes.limitations: Bounded search—not an exhaustive national/territorial sweep. Search results often surfaced older or out-of-country stories; indexing and publication delays particularly affect rural providers, ambulance services and territories. No unsupported claim of absence of events across all providers.
coverage_notes.controls: One append-only private heartbeat on ops/watch-ledger. No approvals, public release, production collector changes, schedule alteration, or task disabling.
